verdict.rationale: PagerDuty explicitly ships a Status Pages product tied to incident state, described as giving real-time operational updates as a single source of truth (docs-10, docs-17, docs-24, docs-29), which is the core ask. However, the evidence never confirms specifics like custom domain support or subscriber notification/subscription mechanics for the hosted page. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom domain configuration, subscriber email/SMS notification features, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these specifics.
